jobs.title: Supply Chain Transformation Program Manager
jobs.description: WD is building the infrastructure behind the AI-driven data economy. As AI scales, so does data. Every interaction, every model, every system generates data that must be stored, managed, and made accessible over time. That’s where we come in. We combine deep engineering expertise with global-scale manufacturing to deliver the storage systems that make AI possible, powering hyperscale data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise infrastructure worldwide. This isn’t theoretical work. It’s real systems, at real scale, people solving some of the hardest challenges in technology today. We’re looking for people who want to build, solve, and operate at that level. Join us and let’s shape the future of data. Western Digital is expanding its Supply Chain Transformation organization to strengthen hands-on delivery capacity for high-priority, cross-functional initiatives. We are seeking a Program Manager to lead process, solution and technology delivery for transformation programs. You will translate approved end-to-end designs into executable delivery plans and drive coordinated execution across requirements, design, build, testing, readiness, deployment, stabilization and transition to the run-the-business organization. This is an execution-focused leadership role for someone who can connect strategy to delivery, bring clarity to complex dependencies and move matrixed teams toward decisions and closure. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Lead the process, solution and technology delivery workstream for highly critical Supply Chain transformation initiatives. Convert integrated process and solution designs into practical program plans covering scope, milestones, deliverables, resources, dependencies, decision points and acceptance criteria. Coordinate planning and delivery across a diverse group of internal and external stakeholders & partners. Maintain the integrated workstream plan and operating cadence; lead status reviews, milestone governance, decision logs, actions and executive-ready reporting. Identify and actively manage risks, issues, assumptions and cross-workstream dependencies; escalate material decisions with clear options, impacts and recommendations. Keep business requirements, process designs, data needs, technical solutions, integrations and deployment activities synchronized across delivery teams. Partner with functional leaders to coordinate user acceptance testing, business readiness, training inputs, adoption activities and transition deliverables. Partner with IT to govern design, build, release and stabilization activities while maintaining clear accountability for technical implementation. Plan and orchestrate go-live, cutover, hypercare and stabilization, including readiness criteria, contingency planning and issue-resolution governance. Drive a structured handoff to the Supply Chain Center of Excellence, business functions and IT, including operating procedures, ownership, open items, performance measures and sustainment responsibilities. Monitor delivery progress and value realization against approved outcomes, surfacing variances and corrective actions to transformation and business leadership. Support vendor and partner governance, including deliverable quality, commitments, resource alignment, commercial dependencies and escalation paths. Apply consistent program and project management standards, templates and controls while tailoring the delivery approach to initiative complexity and pace. Promote speed, operational rigor and customer focus through transparent execution, disciplined follow-through and continuous improvement of the transformation delivery model. Required qualifications Significant experience leading complex business transformation, technology implementation or enterprise program delivery in supply chain, operations or a related environment. Demonstrated success managing cross-functional workstreams spanning business process, data, technology, testing, deployment and operational readiness. Strong program and project management capability, including integrated planning, dependency management, risk and issue governance, milestone control and executive reporting. Experience partnering with business leaders, Business Process Owners, IT teams, architects, data teams, vendors and implementation partners in a matrixed organization. Ability to translate strategic objectives and solution designs into executable delivery plans and drive teams to decisions and closure. Experience coordinating user acceptance testing, go-live, cutover, stabilization and transition to operational ownership. Strong facilitation, communication, stakeholder leadership and structured problem-solving skills. Preferred qualifications Experience in a global, vertically integrated manufacturing, semiconductor or high-technology environment. Experience delivering supply chain planning, Command Center, Control Tower, ERP, analytics, automation or AI-enabled capabilities. Experience with Kinaxis Maestro or another advanced planning platform and integrations across enterprise planning and execution systems. Experience governing systems integrators, software vendors or consulting partners and managing complex contractual deliverables. Familiarity with Agile, iterative and hybrid delivery methods and the judgment to select fit-for-purpose governance. jobs.title: Senior Producer, Video
jobs.location: San Francisco, California, USA; Remote: USA
jobs.description: Why Harvey At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come. This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched. Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you. At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started. Role Overview The Senior Producer, Video joins Harvey's Creative Operations team to lead end-to-end video production that brings the Harvey brand to life across campaigns, social series, product storytelling, and customer narratives. The team sits within Harvey's creative studio and partners with designers, motion artists, and cross-functional marketing stakeholders to produce high-quality visual content at startup speed. You'll work with our senior producers to plan and run productions: scopes, budgets, schedules, crews, vendors, and delivery. You'll work with the Creative Directors leading video and the Content & Social team every day, turning their ideas and roadmap into realistic production plans and helping get finished work out on time. The role includes regular travel for shoots. What You'll Do Support production across Harvey's video slate from brief through delivery. That includes recurring social series, executive content, event coverage, product launches, use-case explainers, and brand campaigns. You'll often juggle several projects at once on one- to two-week turnarounds, and lead smaller productions yourself. Take in briefs from Creative Directors and Content & Social leads, and coordinate with Product Marketing, Brand, Comms, and Events to secure inputs. Ask the questions that clarify objectives, audience, and deliverables, flag gaps before they become problems, and plan shoots around every channel version and cutdown. Help manage timelines, budgets, and scopes of work, and keep stakeholders informed across every workstream. Source, book, and coordinate production agencies, freelance crews, editors, and post vendors, and help grow the vendor roster as the program scales. Support shoots in the studio, at the office, on location, and at events, with executives and non-professional talent. That covers preparing interview subjects, locations, permits, talent releases, call sheets, equipment, travel, and on-set logistics. Run post-production with editors, motion designers, and post vendors through edit, sound, color, captions, and platform deliverables. Keep review rounds tight and projects moving, often while you're in pre-production on the next shoot. Manage the organization and storage of final files, project files, and raw footage from vendors and editors, so every asset is easy to find and reuse. Help build and maintain the processes, templates, and systems the team relies on: intake, scheduling, budget tracking, asset management, release tracking, and gear. What You Have 6+ years of professional video production experience, in-house at a technology company or at an agency or production company, with a strong focus on live-action productions from brief through delivery. A track record producing high-volume social video: recurring series, vertical and short-form formats, event content, and fast-turn edits for LinkedIn, YouTube, Instagram, and X. Experience sourcing and managing production agencies, vendors, and freelance crews across the full production lifecycle, including budgets, scopes of work, and contracts. Experience producing shoots with executives and other non-professional talent, and knowing how to make a senior subject comfortable on camera. Strong post-production skills. You know the workflow from assembly through finishing and delivery, and you have working knowledge of Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, and Frame.io . Strong organization. You run pre-production and post across multiple projects at once, against competing deadlines and budgets, and you're comfortable with regular travel. Strong interpersonal skills and calm under pressure. You keep internal stakeholders and external partners aligned without being the loudest person in the room, and you bring structure to ambiguity. Nice to Have Experience in legal, financial services, or another professional services environment where the subjects are senior and the subject matter is technical, and an interest in the legal industry. Experience with product launches, keynotes, or major marketing moments at scale. Knowledge of delivery formats and platform requirements across web, social, events, and sales enablement. Experience building or scaling video production programs or workflows. Hands-on shooting or editing for small, fast productions. Compensation $128,800 - $177,100 USD Depending on your location, an Applicant Privacy Notice may apply to you. You can find all of our Applicant Privacy Notices here . #LI-LR1 Harvey is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made by emailing accommodations@harvey.ai

jobs.description: ABOUT THE TEAM Business Marketing helps knowledge workers, developers, and business decision-makers understand and adopt OpenAI’s products, supporting both self-serve growth and our managed sales team. Our creative work makes complex capabilities clear, grounded, and human as they move from the lab into businesses and everyday work. You’ll help shape the right creative and video approach for each launch, then lead production from brief through delivery. Most launches center on owned and social channels, and leverage video as a primary medium to explain new products and capabilities. Our largest launches also shape broader brand marketing, requiring coordination with Integrated Marketing and Media. This role combines building the system with running the work. You should be equally comfortable improving a workflow, leading a shoot, and partnering with a motion designer. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL Lead launch intake and planning, aligning creative scope, resources, and timelines with launch priorities. Partner with Product Marketing, Integrated Marketing, creative leads, and subject-matter experts to translate launch goals, audiences, messaging, and technical capabilities into compelling briefs, scripts, demos, and customer stories. Produce videos at varying levels of fidelity, including demos, motion graphics, sizzle videos, explainers, and talking-head or testimonial videos featuring OpenAI talent and customers. Lead production end to end: budgets, schedules, resourcing, shoots, post-production, and delivery. Consolidate feedback and approvals, manage dependencies, and surface risks and decisions early so assets are ready to ship. Coordinate usage rights, accessibility, quality control, and final delivery requirements with the relevant partners. Strong storytelling and creative judgment, with hands-on experience leading video shoots and working with motion designers, editors, and other production specialists. jobs.description:
Get excited to join Scopely’s AI-native incubation team, which is focused on discovering the next generation of mobile games. This role can be remote in the US or hybrid in Culver City, LA.

Rather than spending years developing a single title, we believe one of the most effective ways to find great games is to rapidly transform ideas into playable experiences, launch them to real players, and learn from live market feedback.

We’re pioneering a new approach to game creation—one in which AI enables creators to work across traditional discipline boundaries, take greater ownership of ideas from concept through launch, and bring more great games to players.

What You’ll Do

If you’re a producer who is excited by rapid experimentation, comfortable creating clarity in ambiguous environments, and loves helping teams bring new ideas to life, you’ll feel at home on this team.

We don’t organize our work strictly around traditional disciplines. We believe AI enables skilled creators to contribute to more of the game development process than ever before. As a Producer, you’ll create the structure, workflows, and momentum that allow a small, AI-native team to move quickly from idea to live game. You’ll help shape schedules and roadmaps, keep shared development work moving, manage the build and release process, and contribute hands-on to prototype and game development.

  • Build and maintain schedules across concept development, prototyping, production, testing, release, and live iteration.
  • Help define the team’s roadmap, development goals, milestones, dependencies, and decision points.
  • Manage the backlog and roadmap for shared infrastructure, frameworks, tools, and reusable features, balancing immediate game needs with investments that benefit future Horton projects.
  • Partner with engineers, designers, artists, analytics, user acquisition, and product leads to move games from prototypes to live tests.
  • Manage builds, QA, submissions, releases, and post-launch updates across testing and distribution platforms.
  • Establish release-readiness criteria, track issues and dependencies, and coordinate triage and go/no-go decisions.
  • Manage external development and service providers, including relationships, scopes, schedules, deliverables, and day-to-day communication.
  • Work with central legal, procurement, finance, and other groups to secure external resources and manage MSAs, SOWs, contracts, purchase orders, and vendor onboarding.
  • Use AI tools to improve planning, documentation, production workflows, communication, and game development.
  • Contribute hands-on to prototype and game development, using AI-native tools and workflows to unblock work and help turn ideas into playable experiences.

What We’re Looking For

  • Demonstrated experience using AI tools as a meaningful part of your production, product, or development workflow.
  • Experience in game production, product operations, release management, or a closely related role. Mobile game experience is strongly preferred.
  • A track record of managing schedules, roadmaps, backlogs, dependencies, and cross-functional development teams.
  • Experience coordinating builds, QA, platform submissions, releases, and post-launch updates.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to create clarity and momentum in ambiguous environments.
  • Experience managing external developers, vendors, or service providers.
  • Familiarity with MSAs, SOWs, contracts, procurement, and vendor onboarding processes. You do not need to draft legal documents, but you should be comfortable owning the process and follow-through.
  • Comfort working hands-on with modern game engines, development tools, project-management systems, and release pipelines.
  • A bias toward building, testing, learning, and iterating quickly rather than relying on lengthy planning cycles.
  • The ability to balance speed, quality, risk, and team capacity while keeping work moving.
  • A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively across engineering, design, art, product, analytics, user acquisition, legal, procurement, and external partners.
  • Passion for games and curiosity about how AI will change the way games are created and shipped.
  • Build repeatable production and release practices that can scale across Horton and Scopely.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience building shared tools, frameworks, or production processes across multiple projects.
  • Experience working in small, highly autonomous teams or startup environments.
  • Experience shipping multiple mobile games or prototypes.
  • Familiarity with Unity, Unreal, Godot, or other modern game engines.
  • Experience with mobile app-store submissions, live-service releases, analytics, or user acquisition testing.

For candidates in CA, CO, NJ, NY, and WA, the annual salary range is provided below. In addition to base pay, employees may be eligible for equity, bonuses, and a comprehensive benefits package, including healthcare benefits, retirement benefits, pet insurance, paid holidays, paid Scopely free days, and unlimited paid time off. Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

$91,300—$150,000 USD

 

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

jobs.title: Partner Program Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are 

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! 

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Partner Program Manager.

About the job

As we scale our global partner ecosystem, reliable execution and team collaboration are the foundation of our success. We are seeking a highly organized, execution-focused Partner Program Manager to manage our daily Partner Operations & Commercial Systems workflows. If you bring a strong "can-do" attitude, thrive in a heads-down environment clearing issues and resolving tickets, and have hands-on experience maintaining data accuracy across CRM and PRM systems, this role is an exciting opportunity to keep Twilio's partner engine running smoothly.

In this role, you will be the operational backbone of the global partner program. Sitting within the Partner Operations & Commercial Systems pillar, your primary focus will be managing day-to-day operations: clearing support queues, reviewing partner applications, processing deal registrations, and fielding direct inquiries from our unmanaged partner desk.

As a true team player, you will work closely with cross-functional partners to ensure tasks are completed accurately and on time. You will take ownership of onboarding SLAs, and proactively lean in to keep daily operations moving without friction.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Ticket & Queue Management: Serve as the primary operator for the partner desk, consistently clearing daily Zendesk and CRM queues for partner applications, support inquiries, and directory listings.
  • Deal Registration & Lead Routing: Manually review, verify, and route inbound deal registrations and co-selling feeds, ensuring high data accuracy and strict adherence to turnaround SLAs.
  • Data Hygiene & Maintenance: Execute the day-to-day administrative and data-entry tasks required to keep our ecosystem running, maintaining accurate records across platforms like Salesforce and Airtable.
  • Process Execution & Incremental Improvement: Maintain laser focus on executing existing manual workflows with precision and speed. While executing the day-to-day is the priority, you will also be encouraged to flag bottlenecks and share ideas for future process automation.
  • PRM Experience: Familiarity with Partner Relationship Management (PRM) platforms (Impartner) and account mapping utilities (like Crossbeam).
  • Ecosystem Understanding: Understanding of standard channel models (Resell, Referral, ISV, SI) and standard partner support inquiries.

Location

This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA, WA.

Travel 

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately <XX%> travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way. 

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  • Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $96,640 - $120,800.
  • Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $102,240 - $127,800.
  • Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $113,600 - $142,000.
  • This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Application deadline information 

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until November 30,2026, but may change based on business needs. 

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.
